Corollary
1. ch4:4.14\group ch04-poisson-newtonian-potential Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0079 If $\varphi \in C^{2,\alpha }(\overline B)$ and $f\in C^\alpha (\overline B)$, then $\Delta u=f$ in $B$, $u=\varphi $ on $\partial B$, has a unique $u\in C^{2,\alpha }(\overline B)$.
Proof

\sketch Apply Theorems 7 and 30 to $u-\varphi $.

□
